rv.q: Porn Play is by turns funny and disturbing – a welcome and bold addition to the growing discourse surrounding sex and the internet.
This is an uneven but bold probing of a dirty little secret in society that finds, in Ambika Mod, an eloquent expression of underlying pain.
It's a bold play with a fantastically committed performance from Mod.
This new play... is a mess of provocations, as elliptical and frustrating as it is sparky and inquisitive... but for all its nebulous muddle, in Josie Rourke’s striking production, it compels.
We, like everyone in Ani's life, feel very distant from her.
In Porn Play’s final moments, shame and grief mingle together in a harrowing display that shows not only the skill of its lead performer, but the craft of its ambitious young writer.

cn.t: Ambika Mod delivers a committed performance in this bold but uneven exploration of female porn addiction that divides critics—some praise its provocative ambition and harrowing moments, while others find it frustratingly distant and muddled.
